text: Put saliva on your belly button first thing when you wake up. Without brushing your teeth, without talking to anyone, and activate the protection and abundance of your day, before the world enters you, your fasting saliva is one of the purest substances your body produces. During the night, your organism cleanses itself and concentrates compounds in your saliva that carry your most authentic essence. Before speaking, before eating, that saliva is 100% yours without contamination from anything or anyone. Your belly button was your first channel of life and continues to be one of the most receptive points of your body. When you unite your pure saliva with your center, you are sealing your energetic field before going out into the world. Do this, put a little saliva on your belly button, place your hand on top and say silently, I protect my day, I protect my path, health, love, and abundance belong to me, I accept it. Stay a moment in silence, feeling the warmth of your hand over the center of your body. Do this for three mornings in a row. The first morning seals, the second strengthens, the third activates. Many people notice that after the third day, things start moving differently. A calm they didn't expect. Situations that unblock themselves. A feeling of being protected that they didn't have before. Keep this to yourself while you do it. What you protect in silence works with more strength. Write in the comments, My day is protected if you're going to do it tomorrow. But I want you to understand something. Rituals seal and protect. But if fear, stress, and emotions you carry, without letting go, still live inside you, your own energy weighs on you more than anything from outside. True protection is not a gesture in the morning. It is an inner state. The day you live from calmness, nothing from outside can touch you. And if you want to build that inner protection that doesn't depend on any ritual, I've been learning in silence for more than 20 years how to do it. And everything I know is inside the path back to calmness. The link is in my profile.
